messages:
julia_cs: Quick capture from three onboarding calls today  consistent ask: per-route finance export + one renewal flagged. Short buckets below.
omar_onboard: saw same in Nova & Brightlane trials. Quote: 'finance insists on line-item route costs'.
kevin_prod: paste asks + severity and I'll triage. If renewal risk, we'll P0.
julia_cs: asks:
- per-route export (high): server-side CSV + API, columns: date, route, env, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd. Brightlane marked renewal-risk (4w).
- embeddings refresh (med): scheduled re-embed / TTL for streaming docs.
- latency-priority toggle (med): route-level option for low-latency mode during business hours.
maya_eng: Q: export needs exact billing parity or documented daily aggregates?
omar_onboard: customers want authoritative numbers they can reconcile; daily batch is fine.
kevin_prod: triage suggestion: P0 per-route export for accounts <8w to renewal; P1 embeddings refresh; P2 latency toggle.
maya_eng: I'll prototype a CSV schema with columns and post a sample by EOD.
reminder_bot: Reminder: CS/Product sync in 48h at 10:00 PT. Thread auto-added to agenda under "renewal signals".
kevin_prod: I'll create a GH triage issue and attach call notes + verbatim quotes. Add export UI wireframe request for the sync.
julia_cs: thanks — marking Brightlane high-risk in the tracker and adding this thread to the renewal plan.
